name: USAMO
description: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad is a proof-based mathematics competition for top high school students. Problems require writing rigorous mathematical proofs across areas including algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. One of the most prestigious math competitions in the US.
typical_sota_score: partial credit on some problems; no model achieves consistent full solutions
reputation: Most prestigious US math olympiad; gateway to IMO team selection; extremely difficult proof-based problems
notes: Extremely difficult proof-based competition. Evaluation is challenging for LLMs because proofs require formal rigor. USAMO 2025 problems were used as benchmarks in several frontier model evaluations.
